style.name: Gustav Klimt
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Gustav Klimt for global-news posters, using luminous gold leaf, mosaic ornament, flattened decorative fields, rhythmic geometric borders and elegant symbolic silhouettes while keeping facts, data, maps and scene-specific infographics dominant. Xiazi and Doudou stay small at the edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 跨境出口新框架、AI连接物理设备、代理型一人公司、战争与道路安全、海平面、体育和太空任务构成今日全球图景
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者需要同时管理数据责任、工具权限、人员安全与长期基础设施暴露
zh-CN.headlineFull: 跨境出口新框架、AI连接物理设备、代理型一人公司、战争与道路安全、海平面、体育和太空任务构成今日全球图景；经营者需要同时管理数据责任、工具权限、人员安全与长期基础设施暴露
zh-CN.intro: 印度库存式跨境电商框架、Anthropic模型硬件标准和代理成为客户的OPC趋势改变经营工具箱；基辅仓库袭击、津巴布韦车祸、海平面风险、曲棍球世界杯决赛和Roman望远镜发射补齐安全、韧性与未来信号。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 全球热点落到经营表上，最终都是责任、权限、交付和安全。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先圈出今天会改变一个订单、一条路线或一次复核的那格。

en-US.headlineFact: A new cross-border export framework, AI hardware control, agent-native solo firms, war and road safety, sea levels, sport and a space mission shape today's global picture
en-US.headlineView: operators need to manage data responsibility, tool permissions, human safety and long-term infrastructure exposure together
en-US.headlineFull: A new cross-border export framework, AI hardware control, agent-native solo firms, war and road safety, sea levels, sport and a space mission shape today's global picture; operators need to manage data responsibility, tool permissions, human safety and long-term infrastructure exposure together
en-US.intro: India's inventory-based e-commerce export framework, Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard and the OPC trend of agents becoming customers reshape the operating toolkit; the Kyiv warehouse strike, Zimbabwe road crash, sea-level risk, hockey World Cup final and Roman telescope launch complete the safety, resilience and future signals.
en-US.xiaziQuote: On an operating sheet, global news becomes responsibility, permission, delivery and safety.
en-US.doudouQuote: Circle the cell that changes an order, a route or a review today.

sources.title: Global risk and business signals for August 30, 2026
Explosions reportedly kill at least 37 outside Kyiv city
sources.publisher: UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine

zh-CN.headlineFact: 印度DGFT实施库存式跨境电商出口便利框架，明确Seller-on-Record与Exporter-on-Record的责任链
zh-CN.headlineView: 平台化出口正在把商品来源、订单归属、付款与出口优惠变成可追溯数据
zh-CN.headlineFull: 印度DGFT实施库存式跨境电商出口便利框架，明确Seller-on-Record与Exporter-on-Record的责任链；平台化出口正在把商品来源、订单归属、付款与出口优惠变成可追溯数据
zh-CN.intro: 新框架允许出口商整合印度卖家的库存完成跨境订单，但要求确认出口订单、记录商品原产地、按卖家分配出口利益并防止库存转入国内市场。卖家需要在发货前把商品、订单、付款和报关主体对齐。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境便利不是少留数据，而是让每个角色的数据彼此对得上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先画清谁卖货、谁出口、谁收款、谁拿退税。

en-US.headlineFact: India's DGFT operationalized an inventory-based cross-border e-commerce export framework that defines Seller-on-Record and Exporter-on-Record duties
en-US.headlineView: platformized exports are turning product origin, order ownership, payment and export benefits into traceable data
en-US.headlineFull: India's DGFT operationalized an inventory-based cross-border e-commerce export framework that defines Seller-on-Record and Exporter-on-Record duties; platformized exports are turning product origin, order ownership, payment and export benefits into traceable data
en-US.intro: The framework lets exporters aggregate inventory from Indian sellers for cross-border orders, while requiring confirmed export orders, origin records, seller-attributable benefits and safeguards against diversion into the domestic market. Sellers should align product, order, payment and customs roles before dispatch.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Trade facilitation means every role's data reconciles, not that less data exists.
en-US.doudouQuote: Map who sells, exports, gets paid and receives the rebate.

sources.title: Operationalisation of the Inventory based Cross Border E Commerce Facilitation Framework
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Foreign Trade, India

zh-CN.headlineFact: Anthropic预览Model Hardware Standard，尝试让AI代理用统一接口控制显微镜、机械臂和实验室设备
zh-CN.headlineView: 模型走进物理世界后，能力扩张必须与设备权限、动作确认和审计记录同步
zh-CN.headlineFull: Anthropic预览Model Hardware Standard，尝试让AI代理用统一接口控制显微镜、机械臂和实验室设备；模型走进物理世界后，能力扩张必须与设备权限、动作确认和审计记录同步
zh-CN.intro: 该开放标准希望让模型不必为每台设备编写专用连接，通过结构化描述发现和操作硬件。统一接口能降低自动化成本，也会放大误操作范围；部署者需要为危险动作设置限权、模拟、人工确认和可回滚日志。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI接上机器的那一刻，提示词就变成了安全边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先让它在模拟器里伸手，再碰真实按钮。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Anthropic previewed the Model Hardware Standard, a common interface for AI agents to control microscopes, robotic arms and lab equipment
en-US.headlineView: as models enter the physical world, capability growth must be matched by device permissions, action confirmation and audit trails
en-US.headlineFull: Anthropic previewed the Model Hardware Standard, a common interface for AI agents to control microscopes, robotic arms and lab equipment; as models enter the physical world, capability growth must be matched by device permissions, action confirmation and audit trails
en-US.intro: The proposed open standard aims to let models discover and operate hardware through structured descriptions instead of bespoke connectors for every device. A common interface can reduce automation cost while widening the blast radius of mistakes, so deployments need least privilege, simulation, human confirmation and rollback logs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When AI connects to machinery, the prompt becomes a safety boundary.
en-US.doudouQuote: Let it reach in simulation before it touches a real switch.

zh-CN.headlineFact: OPC Report指出代理正在成为产品客户，单人创业机会从再造聊天框转向可被CLI、API或MCP调用的垂直同事
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司的杠杆不只来自更快开发，而是把专业场景做成机器可购买、可执行、可审计的结果
zh-CN.headlineFull: OPC Report指出代理正在成为产品客户，单人创业机会从再造聊天框转向可被CLI、API或MCP调用的垂直同事；一人公司的杠杆不只来自更快开发，而是把专业场景做成机器可购买、可执行、可审计的结果
zh-CN.intro: 本周趋势把编码代理、浏览器、钱包、按次支付和控制平面连成一条新价值链。单人经营者更适合选择熟悉的高频工作，提供清晰入口、费用上限、审批点和交付凭证，而不是继续包装通用模型。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 下一位客户可能没有鼠标，却会读接口、预算和结果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 给产品留一扇代理能进、账单能看、动作能停的门。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: OPC Report says agents are becoming customers, shifting solo-founder opportunity from another chat box to vertical coworkers callable through CLI, API or MCP
en-US.headlineView: the solo-company advantage is not only faster building but packaging expertise into outcomes machines can buy, execute and audit
en-US.headlineFull: OPC Report says agents are becoming customers, shifting solo-founder opportunity from another chat box to vertical coworkers callable through CLI, API or MCP; the solo-company advantage is not only faster building but packaging expertise into outcomes machines can buy, execute and audit
en-US.intro: This week's signals connect coding agents, browsers, wallets, per-request payments and control planes into a new value chain. Solo operators can pick one familiar high-frequency job and provide a clear entry point, spend cap, approval gate and delivery receipt instead of wrapping another general model.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Your next customer may have no mouse but can read an interface, budget and result.
en-US.doudouQuote: Give the product a door agents can enter, bill and stop.

sources.title: Agents Become the Customer: How Solo Founders Capture the August 2026 Agent-Stack Dividend

zh-CN.headlineFact: 俄军无人机击中基辅以西Myla一处仓库并引发连续爆炸，乌方报告至少37人死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 军事物资、居民区和关键仓储距离过近，会让一次打击迅速扩大为复合型平民灾难
zh-CN.headlineFull: 俄军无人机击中基辅以西Myla一处仓库并引发连续爆炸，乌方报告至少37人死亡；军事物资、居民区和关键仓储距离过近，会让一次打击迅速扩大为复合型平民灾难
zh-CN.intro: 联合国人权监测团正核实伤亡与现场细节；乌方同时调查仓库是否存放弹药以及选址和管理是否合规。事件显示防空之外还需要分散储存、缓冲区、消防通道和可执行的疏散预案。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 战争中的仓库位置，也是一条生命安全边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图上要同时标出目标、住宅、风向和撤离路。

en-US.headlineFact: A Russian drone hit a warehouse in Myla west of Kyiv, triggering repeated explosions as Ukrainian authorities reported at least 37 deaths
en-US.headlineView: when military stores, homes and critical warehousing sit too close together, one strike can become a compound civilian disaster
en-US.headlineFull: A Russian drone hit a warehouse in Myla west of Kyiv, triggering repeated explosions as Ukrainian authorities reported at least 37 deaths; when military stores, homes and critical warehousing sit too close together, one strike can become a compound civilian disaster
en-US.intro: The UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission is verifying casualties and circumstances, while Ukrainian authorities investigate whether ammunition was stored there and whether siting rules were followed. Beyond air defense, the event points to dispersed storage, buffer zones, fire access and executable evacuation plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: In war, warehouse location is also a human-safety boundary.
en-US.doudouQuote: Map the target, homes, wind and evacuation route together.

sources.title: Explosions reportedly kill at least 37 outside Kyiv city
sources.publisher: UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine

zh-CN.headlineFact: 津巴布韦一辆载有教会成员的面包车与超车中的重型卡车迎面相撞，造成27人死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 高风险超车、客运超载与重型货运混行让一次判断失误变成群体伤亡
zh-CN.headlineFull: 津巴布韦一辆载有教会成员的面包车与超车中的重型卡车迎面相撞，造成27人死亡；高风险超车、客运超载与重型货运混行让一次判断失误变成群体伤亡
zh-CN.intro: 事故发生在Harare—Masvingo公路Chivhu附近，幸存者仍在救治。道路安全不仅依赖驾驶者，还取决于车辆容量、营运监管、超车视距、货车路线和紧急救援响应是否共同形成约束。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 道路上的一秒冒险，常由整车乘客共同承担后果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 看见实线、盲弯和满载客车时，慢下来就是最短路线。

en-US.headlineFact: A minibus carrying church members collided head-on with an overtaking haulage truck in Zimbabwe, killing 27 people
en-US.headlineView: dangerous passing, overloaded passenger transport and heavy freight sharing one corridor can turn one decision into mass casualties
en-US.headlineFull: A minibus carrying church members collided head-on with an overtaking haulage truck in Zimbabwe, killing 27 people; dangerous passing, overloaded passenger transport and heavy freight sharing one corridor can turn one decision into mass casualties
en-US.intro: The crash occurred near Chivhu on the Harare-Masvingo highway, with survivors still receiving treatment. Road safety depends not only on drivers but on capacity limits, operating oversight, passing sight distance, freight routing and emergency response working as one system.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One second of road risk can impose its cost on an entire vehicle.
en-US.doudouQuote: At a blind bend beside a full minibus, slowing down is the shortest route.

sources.title: Zimbabwe minibus taxi carrying church members crashes, killing 27

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国警告海洋上升速度已快于有记录以来任何时期，沿海社区、港口和淡水系统面临叠加风险
zh-CN.headlineView: 海平面不是遥远平均值，而是保险、选址、排水、供应链和迁移成本的共同变量
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国警告海洋上升速度已快于有记录以来任何时期，沿海社区、港口和淡水系统面临叠加风险；海平面不是遥远平均值，而是保险、选址、排水、供应链和迁移成本的共同变量
zh-CN.intro: 海水上升会与风暴潮、侵蚀、盐水入侵和地面沉降相互放大。城市和企业需要把不同年份的水位情景写进资产寿命、港口冗余、排水能力、保险条款和有序撤离计划。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 海平面每上升一格，岸上的成本表就要重算一次。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先问这栋楼、这座港口和这条路要用到哪一年。

en-US.headlineFact: The UN warns the ocean is rising faster than at any point in recorded history, compounding risks to coastal communities, ports and freshwater systems
en-US.headlineView: sea level is not a distant average but a shared variable in insurance, siting, drainage, supply chains and migration cost
en-US.headlineFull: The UN warns the ocean is rising faster than at any point in recorded history, compounding risks to coastal communities, ports and freshwater systems; sea level is not a distant average but a shared variable in insurance, siting, drainage, supply chains and migration cost
en-US.intro: Rising seas amplify storm surge, erosion, saltwater intrusion and land subsidence. Cities and companies need time-bounded water scenarios in asset life, port redundancy, drainage capacity, insurance terms and orderly relocation plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Every step in sea level forces another calculation on shore.
en-US.doudouQuote: Ask how long this building, port and road must last.

sources.title: Rising seas, rising stakes: What increasing sea-levels mean to humanity

zh-CN.headlineFact: 阿根廷在曲棍球世界杯决赛常规时间1比1后，通过点球大战3比1击败卫冕冠军荷兰
zh-CN.headlineView: 冠军在开放比赛的节奏控制与点球阶段的单次执行之间完成转换
zh-CN.headlineFull: 阿根廷在曲棍球世界杯决赛常规时间1比1后，通过点球大战3比1击败卫冕冠军荷兰；冠军在开放比赛的节奏控制与点球阶段的单次执行之间完成转换
zh-CN.intro: 双方在决赛中未能于常规时间分出胜负，阿根廷在点球大战中更稳定地完成机会并终结荷兰卫冕。对团队而言，淘汰赛训练不仅是整体体系，也包括压力下可重复的个人动作和门将决策。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 决赛的体系负责把比赛拖进机会，执行负责把机会变成冠军。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 点球很短，准备它的时间却贯穿整个赛季。

en-US.headlineFact: Argentina beat defending champion Netherlands 3-1 in a shootout after a 1-1 regulation draw in the Hockey World Cup final
en-US.headlineView: the title required a switch from open-play rhythm control to one-action execution under shootout pressure
en-US.headlineFull: Argentina beat defending champion Netherlands 3-1 in a shootout after a 1-1 regulation draw in the Hockey World Cup final; the title required a switch from open-play rhythm control to one-action execution under shootout pressure
en-US.intro: The finalists could not separate in regulation before Argentina converted more reliably in the shootout to end the Netherlands' title defense. Knockout preparation is both a team system and a set of repeatable individual actions and goalkeeper decisions under pressure.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A final's system creates the chance; execution turns it into a title.
en-US.doudouQuote: A shootout is brief, but its preparation lasts all season.

sources.title: Argentina dethrone Netherlands in Hockey World Cup final

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA确认Nancy Grace Roman空间望远镜进入8月30日发射日，计划搭乘Falcon Heavy前往日地L2
zh-CN.headlineView: 至少百倍于哈勃的视场将把暗能量、暗物质与系外行星研究推进到大规模统计巡天
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA确认Nancy Grace Roman空间望远镜进入8月30日发射日，计划搭乘Falcon Heavy前往日地L2；至少百倍于哈勃的视场将把暗能量、暗物质与系外行星研究推进到大规模统计巡天
zh-CN.intro: Roman定于美国东部时间7时26分从肯尼迪航天中心39A发射台升空，最终在距地球约150万公里的L2附近运行。发射之后仍需完成部署、通信、校准和首光等连续硬门。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 探索宇宙的尺度跃迁，来自把清晰度和视野同时做大。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 倒计时归零后，部署清单才刚翻到第一页。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA confirmed launch day for the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope on August 30 aboard Falcon Heavy toward Sun-Earth L2
en-US.headlineView: a field of view at least 100 times Hubble's will move dark-energy, dark-matter and exoplanet research into large statistical surveys
en-US.headlineFull: NASA confirmed launch day for the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope on August 30 aboard Falcon Heavy toward Sun-Earth L2; a field of view at least 100 times Hubble's will move dark-energy, dark-matter and exoplanet research into large statistical surveys
en-US.intro: Roman is scheduled to lift off at 7:26 a.m. EDT from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center and eventually operate near L2 about 1.5 million kilometers from Earth. Launch is followed by hard gates for deployment, communications, calibration and first light.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A leap in cosmic discovery comes from expanding clarity and field of view together.
en-US.doudouQuote: When the countdown ends, the deployment checklist opens to page one.

sources.title: NASA Roman Space Telescope launch coverage
